newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed on Tuesday as gold failed to make any progress on the upside but the white metals remained firm on Russian supply worries, traders said.
COMEX June was gold was seen opening down $0.30 to $1.00 an ounce from Monday's close at $344.90 an ounce. Bullion was quoted at $342.40/$342.70.
In London gold was fixed at $342.00 Tuesday morning compared with $342.25 on Monday afternoon.
COMEX May silver was called to open flat to up 2.00 cents an ounce, compared to Monday's close at $4.735 an ounce.
New York precious metals ended higher Monday but volumes were light with activity limited by the Passover holiday which officially lasts Monday evening to Tuesday evening.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks slipped 32,309 ounces to 998,995 ounces Monday.
COMEX silver stocks were unchanged at 189,872,972 ounces Monday.
NYMEX July platinum and NYMEX June palladium were called to open flat to $0.50 an ounce weaker despite continuing concern in the market regarding Russian white metal supplies.
Unions in South Africa said that 9,000 workers have been locked out of Lonrho's Western Platinum mine since Friday after staging a two-hour protest.
